title: Result file templates
summary: Describe an instrument export, inspect its mapping and check a sample before source approval.

sections.title: How to use this page
paragraphs: New file template records the source software and export layout. Open a sample export, choose its encoding, delimiter and header, then map the sample, analyte, value and other supplied fields. Check the preview before saving a draft.

A saved source page shows the template and provides Check with a file. This check previews interpretation without storing results. Approve source activates the template when the required authority and separation-of-duties conditions are met.

sections.title: Good practice
paragraphs: Describe the export exactly as produced. Verify units, dilution handling, sample-type words and analyte mappings against the laboratory’s approved configuration. Value-word meanings must come from an approved laboratory decision.

Compare the same batch in the source software and the preview. A template check cannot establish that each label belongs to an open run; that is checked during import. Keep the original export unchanged.

sections.title: If you cannot continue
paragraphs: Different headers require the export or its approved template to be corrected. Unexpected blank values or unmapped words need investigation. Do not change a mapping merely to make a sample file pass; confirm what the source actually means.

pages.title: New file template
pages.purpose: Describe a result-file export precisely, map its fields and check a sample before saving a source draft.
pages.access: Requires configuration-management authority and an instrument configured for Result files.

fields.name: Software name
fields.meaning: Declares which software produces this export.
fields.values: Product name from the source installation.
fields.rules: Required, trimmed 1–200 characters. This declaration is displayed with imports; it is not verified from file contents.

fields.name: Software version
fields.meaning: Identifies the declared source version.
fields.values: Installed version text.
fields.rules: Required, trimmed 1–200 characters.

fields.name: Reports final (dilution-corrected) concentrations
fields.meaning: Declares whether the exported numeric values already incorporate dilution.
fields.values: Yes or No.
fields.rules: Required; no default. Do not select Yes unless the source actually reports final concentrations.

fields.name: Sample export / First lines as written
fields.meaning: Provides the file used to inspect headers and mapping.
fields.values: A file selected in the operating-system dialog; the first five raw lines and first 50 parsed lines are previewed.
fields.rules: The sample is held temporarily for checking; only the template/header is saved. Opening a sample imports no results.

fields.name: Encoding
fields.meaning: Specifies how bytes become text.
fields.values: UTF-8 or Windows-1252.
fields.rules: Required; no default unless the file’s byte-order mark determines it, when shown read-only.

fields.name: Delimiter
fields.meaning: Separates fields in each row.
fields.values: Comma, Tab or Semicolon.
fields.rules: Required; no default.

fields.name: Spaces around values
fields.meaning: Determines whether surrounding field spaces are retained.
fields.values: Remove spaces around each value; Keep values exactly as written.
fields.rules: Required; no default. The same setting controls matching of names and words.

fields.name: Header line
fields.meaning: Selects the actual header among the sample’s first lines.
fields.values: One of the first 50 parsed lines, selected by field or row.
fields.rules: Required. Incoming exports must have matching header text within their first 50 lines.

fields.name: Header rows
fields.meaning: Describes a simple or grouped header.
fields.values: One line; Two lines: group labels, then field names.
fields.rules: Required. Two lines must have equal numbers of columns; headers cannot contain embedded line breaks.

fields.name: Shape
fields.meaning: Defines where analyte values occur.
fields.values: Long: one row per sample and analyte; Wide: one row per sample, a column or column group per analyte.
fields.rules: Required; no default.

fields.name: Analyte column / Value column
fields.meaning: Identifies the analyte name and result columns in a long file.
fields.values: Columns from the selected header, with positions and sample values.
fields.rules: Both required for Long; each column can have only one role.

fields.name: Analyte columns
fields.meaning: Chooses the value columns in a wide file with one header line.
fields.values: Checklist of header columns.
fields.rules: At least one required. Only selected columns are read as analytes.

fields.name: Value field
fields.meaning: Chooses the result field repeated under each analyte group.
fields.values: Field names found in the second header line, such as the actual final-concentration field.
fields.rules: Required for a two-line Wide layout; all chosen groups must read this same field.

fields.name: Analyte groups read
fields.meaning: Selects analyte groups to include.
fields.values: Groups that contain the chosen Value field.
fields.rules: All qualifying groups start selected when the value field changes; retain at least one. Groups without the field produce no rows.

fields.name: Sample label column
fields.meaning: Identifies the LIS container label or control/calibrator lot sample label.
fields.values: A selected header column.
fields.rules: Required; cannot share another role.

fields.name: Sample type column
fields.meaning: Identifies the source’s patient/QC classification word.
fields.values: A header column or Not in the file.
fields.rules: Optional. If selected, map its words below; they must agree with actual run roles at import.

fields.name: Flags column
fields.meaning: Preserves source flags alongside evidence.
fields.values: A header column or Not in the file.
fields.rules: Optional; no acceptance decision is inferred.

fields.name: Operator column
fields.meaning: Preserves the operator text supplied by the export.
fields.values: A header column or Not in the file.
fields.rules: Optional; does not impersonate or replace the signed-in LIS user.

fields.name: Acquisition time column
fields.meaning: Preserves when the source says acquisition occurred.
fields.values: A header column or Not in the file.
fields.rules: Optional source metadata.

fields.name: Dilution factor column
fields.meaning: Compares the export’s dilution with the recorded analytical attempt.
fields.values: A header column or Not in the file.
fields.rules: Optional; present values must match the recorded dilution. This does not apply a numeric correction.

fields.name: End of data
fields.meaning: Determines whether a footer should be excluded.
fields.values: At the end of the file; At the first blank line (the export has a footer).
fields.rules: Required; no default. Choose the actual export behavior.

fields.name: Analytes: Catalog analyte
fields.meaning: Maps each source analyte name or selected wide column to its catalog identity.
fields.values: Configured analytes, searchable by name/code.
fields.rules: At least one source mapping required; every chosen wide analyte column must be mapped. Source names are unique, at most 64 characters, without surrounding spaces.

fields.name: Analytes: Not a result
fields.meaning: Counts a long-file name without creating a patient result.
fields.values: Unchecked or checked per source name.
fields.rules: Long files only. A name cannot both map to a catalog analyte and be Not a result. Unmapped names otherwise quarantine.

fields.name: Words: Sample types
fields.meaning: Maps each distinct source word to its material role.
fields.values: Not mapped, Patient, Control, Calibrator or Blank.
fields.rules: One choice per word when a sample-type column exists. No role is inferred from an unmapped word.

fields.name: Words: Value words
fields.meaning: Defines the approved meaning of a nonnumeric source value.
fields.values: Not mapped; Below the limit of quantitation; Below the limit of detection; Not performed.
fields.rules: Map only laboratory-approved meanings. Positive numbers and positive comparator bounds cannot be redefined as words. Empty values always quarantine.

fields.name: Words: Empty values / row counts
fields.meaning: Shows how many sample cells are empty or contain each word.
fields.values: Nonnegative counts.
fields.rules: Read-only. A zero or negative text needs an explicitly approved word mapping if it is a source sentinel; it is not imported as a positive measurement.

fields.name: Units column
fields.meaning: Selects each row’s unit source.
fields.values: Header column or Not in the file.
fields.rules: Optional; units must match the applicable method exactly at import.

fields.name: Declared unit
fields.meaning: Declares the unit when the file has no unit column.
fields.values: Exact method unit text, or blank for a unitless method.
fields.rules: At most 64 characters without surrounding spaces. Cannot be combined with a Units column; that choice makes this read-only as None.

fields.name: Check: row counts
fields.meaning: Reconciles how the template reads the sample.
fields.values: Rows read, Numbers, Censored values, Mapped words, unmapped words, empty values, zero/negative values, malformed values, unmapped analytes, not-result rows, unmapped sample types and malformed record counts.
fields.rules: Read-only diagnostic counts; they do not establish run association or clinical acceptability.

fields.name: Check: Reference / Sample label
fields.meaning: Identifies the source row and sample for comparison with the original export.
fields.values: Original row reference and sample label, or Empty.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Check: Analyte as written / File’s header text / Catalog analyte
fields.meaning: Compares file identity with the catalog mapping.
fields.values: Source analyte name, wide-file header text, mapped analyte, Not a result or Not mapped, quarantined.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Check: Value as written / Value reads as
fields.meaning: Shows original value text and its interpretation.
fields.values: Number, Censored value, mapped-word meaning, or a stated quarantine reason.
fields.rules: Read-only; compare numeric precision and comparator with the source.

fields.name: Check: Sample type
fields.meaning: Shows the source word and mapped role.
fields.values: Patient, Control, Calibrator, Blank, not mapped or None.
fields.rules: Read-only; the actual run position still determines its role.

actions.name: Open a sample export / Open another sample
actions.does: Loads a sample for preview through the system file dialog.
actions.result: Displays its raw and parsed lines. Cancelling opens nothing.

actions.name: Choose a preview row
actions.does: Selects that line as the header.
actions.availableWhen: The sample has been parsed with an encoding and delimiter.

actions.name: Check the sample
actions.does: Applies the current template and mappings to the sample.
actions.availableWhen: The template has sufficient structure and a sample is open.
actions.result: Shows counts and per-row interpretation without storing results. A later template change marks the check out of date.

actions.name: Save draft
actions.does: Validates and records this template as a draft source.
actions.availableWhen: All structural choices and required mappings are valid.
actions.result: Returns to the instrument; imports use it only after approval.

actions.name: Cancel
actions.result: Unsaved input triggers a leave confirmation; accepting it discards the draft form.

restrictions: No more than 20 MiB per file, 50,000 rows, 512 columns or 4 KiB per field can be read.
Each header column has exactly one role. The template matches names and order; renamed, moved, added or removed columns require review.
A sample check does not prove that labels match open runs, units match the chosen method, or work was ordered. Those checks occur at import.

The page has no field for clinical cutoffs; mapped below-limit words use the applicable approved method limits. Word-derived results on dilution work are restricted and must be investigated if refused.
workflow: Enter the declared software identity and dilution behavior.
Open a representative export; select encoding, delimiter, whitespace handling, header, shape and each column role.
Map analytes and approved source words, then define units.
Check the sample and compare every row category with the source export. Recheck after any change, save the draft and proceed to source approval.

troubleshooting.recovery: Check encoding and delimiter, exact header position and file limits. A changed export needs a reviewed new template.

troubleshooting.problem: A column is rejected as duplicate.
troubleshooting.recovery: Assign each column only one meaning; separate the sample-label, analyte, value and optional metadata columns.

troubleshooting.problem: The check shows unmapped words, empty values or wrong analytes.
troubleshooting.recovery: Verify the source meaning and laboratory-approved mapping. Do not assign a clinical meaning just to suppress quarantine.

pages.title: Saved file template
pages.purpose: Inspect a saved source version, compare its interpretation with another file and approve a reviewed draft.
pages.access: Requires access to bench configuration. Approval requires configuration-approval authority and the current separation-of-duties policy.

fields.name: Source identity / State
fields.meaning: Identifies the declared software name/version and source lifecycle.
fields.values: Draft, awaiting approval; Active; Retired.
fields.rules: Read-only; review the instrument breadcrumb to ensure this is the intended source.

fields.name: Reports final concentrations
fields.meaning: Shows the saved dilution declaration.
fields.values: Yes or No.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Encoding without a byte-order mark / Delimiter / Spaces / End of data
fields.meaning: Shows the saved text-reading choices.
fields.values: UTF-8 or Windows-1252; Comma, Tab or Semicolon; remove or keep spaces; end of file or first blank line.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Header lines
fields.meaning: Displays the exact approved header signature.
fields.values: One or two lines of column text in order.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Shape / Analyte column / Value column / Analyte value columns
fields.meaning: Shows how the template finds results.
fields.values: Long column roles or selected Wide value-column mappings.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Sample label column / Sample type column / Flags column / Operator column / Acquisition time column / Dilution factor column
fields.meaning: Shows the saved metadata roles.
fields.values: Header positions/names or None for an optional role.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Units column / Declared unit
fields.meaning: Explains the source of units.
fields.values: A header role, a single declared unit, or None.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Analytes / Not results
fields.meaning: Lists source-code-to-catalog mappings and names counted outside results.
fields.values: Saved mappings and not-result names.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Sample types / Value words / Empty values
fields.meaning: Shows word meanings and the mandatory empty-value rule.
fields.values: Mapped sample roles and below-LOQ, below-LOD or Not performed meanings; Empty values are Always quarantined.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Check: row counts
fields.meaning: Reconciles how the template reads the sample.
fields.values: Rows read, Numbers, Censored values, Mapped words, unmapped words, empty values, zero/negative values, malformed values, unmapped analytes, not-result rows, unmapped sample types and malformed record counts.
fields.rules: Read-only diagnostic counts; they do not establish run association or clinical acceptability.

fields.name: Check: Reference / Sample label
fields.meaning: Identifies the source row and sample for comparison with the original export.
fields.values: Original row reference and sample label, or Empty.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Check: Analyte as written / File’s header text / Catalog analyte
fields.meaning: Compares file identity with the catalog mapping.
fields.values: Source analyte name, wide-file header text, mapped analyte, Not a result or Not mapped, quarantined.
fields.rules: Read-only; supplied by the current record.

fields.name: Check: Value as written / Value reads as
fields.meaning: Shows original value text and its interpretation.
fields.values: Number, Censored value, mapped-word meaning, or a stated quarantine reason.
fields.rules: Read-only; compare numeric precision and comparator with the source.

fields.name: Check: Sample type
fields.meaning: Shows the source word and mapped role.
fields.values: Patient, Control, Calibrator, Blank, not mapped or None.
fields.rules: Read-only; the actual run position still determines its role.

fields.name: Source approval: Confirm self-approval
fields.meaning: Records an explicit acknowledgment when the source author approves their own draft.
fields.values: I confirm that no second person reviewed this.
fields.rules: Appears only when the laboratory separation-of-duties policy permits self-approval and requests confirmation; initially unchecked. It does not override a requirement for another approver.

actions.name: Check with a file / Check with another file
actions.does: Selects a file and reads it using the saved template.
actions.availableWhen: The saved source includes a file layout.
actions.result: Shows temporary per-row interpretation; no receipt or result is imported.

actions.name: Approve source
actions.does: Activates the draft after the confirmation.
actions.availableWhen: Draft source allows approval; authorized approver meets the laboratory separation-of-duties policy.
actions.result: Retires the previous active source. If the author is permitted to approve, explicit self-approval confirmation is still required.

actions.name: Instrument breadcrumb
actions.does: Returns to the source list in Bench setup.
actions.result: Shows the instrument’s current readiness and source history.

restrictions: The saved template is read-only. To change its mapping, draft a new file template from the instrument.
Checking a file neither activates the draft nor imports results. The application does not certify source qualification from a successful preview.
An active or retired source is not a draft awaiting approval. Earlier imports retain which source version they used.
workflow: Compare Text and header, Columns, Analytes and words against the intended export settings.
Use Check with a file and reconcile counts, names, values, units and sample roles against the source.
Approve only after the required laboratory review, then verify the active source on the instrument.

troubleshooting.recovery: Return to the instrument in Bench setup and open the source again.
Check source state, your configuration-approval authority and the laboratory’s separation-of-duties rule.

troubleshooting.problem: An existing file needs reprocessing after approval.
troubleshooting.recovery: Use Retry import on its earlier Result imports attempt; loading identical bytes again is deduplicated.
